verificationMethod.description: Fetched the pinned TBESG source at the locked STEPBible commit and verified all ten target eStrong identities against exact source rows. This is source-row verification only and is not represented as a successful execution of the deterministic adapter.

targets.boundary: deity/god vs the one true God must remain context-sensitive
sovereignty/royal power, concrete kingdom, and Messianic/kingdom-of-God senses must not be flattened
rescue from peril, healing/restoration, and spiritual salvation require contextual separation
change-of-mind lexical history and repentance-from-sin NT use both preserved
Extended Strong subidentity must be preserved; wind/breath, human spirit/disposition, incorporeal spirit, and Holy Spirit senses require context
say/speak/declare/mean/call-name uses must not be collapsed; Extended Strong meaning row preserved
broad righteous/conforming-to-divine-standard and narrower just/rendering-due senses both preserved
person disambiguation is mandatory; source distinguishes multiple Mary identities under disambiguated Strong values
literal name, authority/character represented by the name, cause/ground, and person-count senses preserved
Greek-of Hebrew-name provenance H0175 must be preserved; zero-padding alias G2 is formatting-only
